scope: every tracked regular executable source or operational code file; every line is consumed into a per-file line Merkle root with no depth, extension-family, or representative-sample limit

functional_watermark.line_merkle_algorithm: sha256 ordered line-number plus UTF-8 line bytes
functional_watermark.inter_system_reference_detection: deterministic static reference extraction used only for cascade-link inventory; it does not claim runtime execution

classification_binding.canonical_active: must bind to a direct active Reflexor feature or to the functional watermark capability plus dynamic workspace discovery
classification_binding.workspace_source_surface: must bind to functional watermark plus dynamic workspace Reflexor discovery
classification_binding.operational_tool_surface: must bind to functional watermark plus repository front-door or validation route
classification_binding.nsq_application_or_target_surface: must bind to functional watermark plus NSQ target contract
classification_binding.attributed_upstream_source: must retain upstream provenance and source-availability authority; it is not represented as privately reauthored executable code
classification_binding.vendored_dependency_source: must retain vendoring and license provenance; it is not claimed as native Braxon source
classification_binding.deprecated_historical_only: must be non-routable and identify its canonical successor
